info.name: Handmade API
info.description:
Generated from /openapi/v1.json with sample bodies for local try-outs.

1) Import this collection + Handmade-Local environment
2) Select environment Handmade Local
3) Run Auth → Login (Admin seed) to fill accessToken automatically
4) Replace {{productId}} / {{categoryId}} etc. from responses as you go
